mapper.insert: insert into rabbit_abnormal_conditions (rabbit_id, cage_id, house_id, warning_status, warning_time, img_url, remark, is_deal, create_by, update_by, operator_name) values (#{rabbitId}, #{cageId}, #{houseId}, #{warningStatus}, #{warningTime}, #{imgUrl}, #{remark}, #{isDeal}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, #{operatorName})
mapper.select: select a.* from rabbit_abnormal_conditions a join rabbits r on r.id = a.rabbit_id and r.house_id = a.house_id where a.house_id = #{houseId} and a.cage_id = #{cageId} order by a.warning_time desc, a.id desc limit 1
